title: Void Duel
author: Bobqcarter
selftext:
I posted this the other day but it wasn't really finished. After 50 revisions, its pretty locked in and runs and looks good.

It is free to play against bots or people. I've got it set up where people replace bots and when they leave the game they are turned back into bots.

The room maker hosts, so if they leave the room dies.

Controls are super simple: mouse to move, left fires, right locks player to aim.

I've played it with friends a few times now and its fun.

The bot AI got pretty good and difficulty with all 19 bots is high. 6-8 bots is most fun.

This was made with ChatGPT plus and the build process was really satisfying. I've used devs to make a game for me in the past and it went no where near as smoothly.

This my second crack at making an AI game.

[VoidDuel.com](http://VoidDuel.com)

replies.body: The video was recorded before I fixed it, but I did fix it. It was like the last thing to do and I kept forgetting to do it. That info shows up in the right box now.

replies.author: KnotHeadGames
replies.body: I think it would maybe be smart to transition hosts instead of killing a room when the host leaves. Think of how call of duty handles lobbies, the game doesnt end, they just pause while it transfer.

replies.author: Bobqcarter
replies.body:
The host handles the multiplayer info to the guests. There are no servers or hosting anywhere. A lot of effort went in to reducing as much information transfer as possible to get it to run smooth this way.

I would like to figure out Phaser or Photon or some kind of actual multiplayer system for web games that is also free or nearly, but its all a little over my head.
